lessons.title: Sản phẩm và năng lực thật

files.role: legacy measured cue example; never copy timestamps

techniques: completed state breaks into a contrast
hold after one decisive hit
avoid: Do not reuse the exact product-versus-learning copy or layout.

techniques: both alternatives remain visible
focus transfers without hiding the alternative
avoid: Do not stagger an inherently parallel choice.

techniques: one persistent stage
new question gains focus while earlier text de-emphasizes
avoid: Only use sequential accumulation when the voice itself is sequential.

techniques: clear fulcrum and beam geometry
single hero glow at payoff
avoid: Do not use a lever when the spoken meaning lacks a real balance/advantage relation.

doNotCopy: Cue seconds and SFX positions are historical evidence only.
Do not reproduce the same sequence of nine scenes.
Do not import user voice paths or on-screen copy into a new production.
qualityNotes: Typography enters with a semantic state change, not ambient motion.
One visual focal glow per frame.

lessons.title: AI tạo ra câu trả lời như thế nào?

files.role: legacy measured cue example; never copy timestamps

techniques: surface response separates to reveal a causal layer
no full-screen flash
avoid: Do not use a reveal merely as decoration.

techniques: token movement is sequential because the mechanism is sequential
selection resolves into a completed response
avoid: Do not apply token-by-token motion to ordinary lists.

techniques: two states coexist
focus shifts when the narration changes subject
avoid: Do not crop, shrink, or hide one side without a semantic reason.

techniques: unreachable state stays visually outside the AI system
user moves explicit context into the prompt
avoid: Do not use a decorative X or connector that does not explain a relation.

doNotCopy: Cue seconds and SFX positions are historical evidence only.
Do not reproduce the exact token UI or cell example.
Do not import user voice paths or on-screen copy into a new production.
qualityNotes: Mechanism scenes must communicate correctly when decoration is removed.
Use a hard cut or local exit when the semantic system changes.

lessons.title: Vì sao AI tự tin nhưng vẫn có thể sai?

files.role: orchestrator + voice and sparse SFX mapping
legacy measured cue example; never copy timestamps

techniques: details accumulate into a plausible dossier
the contradiction arrives as a clear state change
avoid: Do not use vague particles or a generic question mark to signify an answer.

techniques: term arrives exactly at its spoken cue
prior claim stays available as context
avoid: Do not delay the named concept after voice has introduced it.

techniques: all condition cards establish together
voice focus moves across the already-legible grid
avoid: Do not reveal equivalent list items as unrelated slides.

techniques: questions accumulate in one stage
each question gets one restrained emphasis
avoid: Do not spam checkmark, pulse, or SFX per line.

doNotCopy: Cue seconds and SFX positions are historical evidence only.
Do not reproduce the fictional book text, risk copy, or exact card geometry.
Do not import user voice paths or on-screen copy into a new production.
qualityNotes: A confidence-versus-trust contrast needs typography with enough space for Vietnamese diacritics.
Every connector or marker must have an explicit relation.
